description: A curated starter dataset of 100 startups and technology companies associated with New York City and San Francisco. Designed as a companion dataset to the contemporary gallery registry for the Office of Cultural Futures project.

scope.selection: Mix of accelerator-associated startups and other notable technology companies with a connection to the listed city. This is a research starter set, not a complete census or a claim that every company is currently headquartered in that city.

schema_notes: location records the city association used for this starter dataset; verify current headquarters before using it as a precise current-HQ claim.

accelerator is the named accelerator or founder program when a relationship is recorded. A null value means no accelerator affiliation is recorded here, not proof that the company never participated in one.
batch is populated only where a batch label is included with reasonable confidence. Null means unverified or not applicable; do not infer a batch from company founding year.
sector is a normalized, multi-label classification authored for this dataset, not necessarily the company's own taxonomy.

source_links includes the company website and, where applicable, the official accelerator/portfolio directory. Directory links are city-level or portfolio-level sources, not always individual company profile pages.
Descriptions are concise summaries for discovery and classification, not quotations from the companies.
